Class VirtualWindowItem

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.item.AItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.PathBasedItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.PolygonItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.RectangleItem
edu.cnu.mdi.view.VirtualWindowItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFeedbackProvider, IDrawable, EventListener
public class VirtualWindowItem extends RectangleItem
A rectangle item, drawn on a VirtualView's annotation layer, that represents one BaseView's thumbnail location within the virtual desktop.

The constructor links the two objects both ways: baseView.setVirtualItem(this) lets the real view drive this item's position, while this item's own drag handling (modify()) is translation-only (not resizable or rotatable) and, on drag completion, moves the represented BaseView to match. Selection is a no-op; these items are not independently selectable/deselectable the way a normal drawn item is.
